# <span id="aanchor419"></span> Exception Directory

## 3200 - 3214

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03200">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3200 QES - Low condensate</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03200">

This exception is generated when a source’s Condensate exceeds the user defined standard deviation limit for minimum Condensate. For example, the standard deviation limit for Condensate is set to 0.0500. The average Condensate from the previous 10 records is = 1.5000. If the current sample has a Condensate of 1.4499 or lower, then exception 3200 will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3201 QES - High full wellstream factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03201">

This exception is generated when a source’s Full Wellstream Factor exceeds the maximum value for Full Wellstream Factor. For example, the maximum limit for Full Wellstream Factor is set to 1.0000, but the Full Wellstream Factor on the sample is imported at 1.0001.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03202">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3202 QES - Low full wellstream factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03202">

This exception is generated when a source’s Full Wellstream Factor exceeds the minimum value for Full Wellstream Factor. For example, the minimum limit for Full Wellstream Factor is set to 1.0000, but the Full Wellstream Factor on the sample is imported at 0.9999.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03203">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3203 QES - High user-defined numeric field 1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03203">

FLOWCAL will compare the User Defined Numeric Field 1 on the current sample to the User Defined Numeric Field 1 on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the User Defined Numeric Field 1 has increased by more than the limit defined in the Expert System validation for User Defined Numeric Field 1.

For example, the current sample has a User Defined Numeric Field 1 value of 100. The limit defined in Expert Systems validation for User Defined Numeric Field 1 is set to 1.0000 Standard Deviation for a record count of 5. If the average for the last 5 samples’ User Defined Numeric Field 1 is equal to 98 with the upper limit = 99, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03204">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3204 QES - Low user-defined numeric field 1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03204">

FLOWCAL will compare the User Defined Numeric Field 1 on the current sample to the User Defined Numeric Field 1 on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the User Defined Numeric Field 1 has decreased by more than the standard deviation limit defined in the Expert System validation for User Defined Numeric Field 1.

For example, the current sample has a User Defined Numeric Field 1 value of 95. The limit defined in Expert Systems validation for User Defined Numeric Field 1 is set to 1.0000 Standard Deviation for a record count of 5. If the average for the last 5 samples’ User Defined Numeric Field 1 is equal to 98 with the lower limit = 97, then this exception will be generated.

</div>
